crossRefs.note: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: As she rode on her donkey, and came down by the covert of the mountain, that behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.
translations.bsb: As Abigail came riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, she saw David and his men coming down toward her, and she met them.
translations.kjv: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
translations.asv: And it was so, as she rode on her ass, and came down by the covert of the mountain, that, behold, David and his men came down toward her; and she met them.
